name: tesla-analyst-2026
description: Hand-curated real analyst questions over Tesla's live indexed corpus, grounded in the fiscal 2025 Form 10-K (filed 2026-01-29). Each question targets the dossier step an analyst asking it would be on: step 2 reads the business and risk Items (1/1A), step 3 reads the financial Items (7/8), step 4 reads the market/returns and MD&A Items (5/7), and a search-everything question spans the corpus. Ground truth references are verbatim snippets of the actual indexed chunks, so they survive a re-ingest that regenerates chunk ids.
